items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. The growth of orbital data and need for real-time services are forcing LEO satellites to use AI processing instead of simple relays. However, AI training needs lots of computing power, memory, and stable connections, which are hard to get in satellite networks with limited resources. Large language models (LLMs) have improved quickly by using scaling laws for training on big text collections. Large Language Models (LLMs) are good at reasoning but too slow for quick decisions needed by AI systems. System 1 models solve this by making decisions in one step instead of token-by-token. Apple has released iOS 27.2, adding new Siri AI language support and important security updates.
